OpenAI announced its advertising unit reached a $1 billion annualized revenue run rate within 200 days of launch and is expanding self-service access to over 40 countries. Why it matters: This milestone demonstrates the rapid commercial viability of integrating advertising into generative AI platforms, providing a critical revenue stream alongside subscriptions and API usage.
